headline: Forced Out?
caption:
Valentina Shevchenko didn't want to give up her UFC title, per Ariel Helwani.
Fair or not? 👇

Helwani says the UFC needed a title fight for Oct. 3, so the injured flyweight champ was asked to vacate, with a promise of a title shot when she returns. Natalia Silva won the vacant belt at UFC 332. UFC news.

Should she get it right back?
question: Fair or not?
